run_subprocess_command: run a subprocess command with captured stdout and stderr in a specified folder
run_interactive_subprocess: run an interactive subprocess with stdin and stdout pipes for two-way communication
capture_terminal_output: capture output printed to terminal using a context manager that redirects sys.stdout
run_subprocess_with_check: run a subprocess command that raises CalledProcessError on non-zero exit codes
run_interactive_git_command: run an interactive git command with stdin/stdout for credential or prompt handling
